description: Council attestation review for himawari — the multi-axis governance record that scopes and signs off every R-stage activation, gate/non-goal amendment, and per-axis constitutional gate review across the whole c-Si chain: feedstock provenance (G2 XUAR/forced-labor exclusion), process chemistry (G3 high-GWP abatement), renewable-only process energy (G4), circularity (G5 ≥90% recovery), metallization roadmap (G6 Ag→Cu), labor-liberation metric (G7), SBOM (G8), land-trust siting (G9), deterministic traceability (G11), no-external-sale (G12), bound transport (G13), and Wellbecoming (G14). Council Lv6+ supermajority (≥3 of the 5-of-7 Safe) is the floor; G4/G5 fossil/nuclear amendments require Lv7 unanimity. This is the gate the module_assembly + polysilicon_refine cells defer their floors to (e.g. G5 recyclability floor, G11 provenance). Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT); each property is one attribute keyed by the record CID, so a lot/batch/serial's review history is queryable as-of any point. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si track. Per ADR-2606021200 (Council Lv6+ ratify).

reviewId.description: himawari-assigned review identifier; root of the kotoba Datom history for this Council review

reviewSubjectId.description: the entity this review scopes — a feedstock lotId / wafer batchId / cell batchId / module serial / R-stage tag / gate-amendment id. Chains to the reviewed record (e.g. polysiliconProvenanceAttestation.lotId, waferBatchRecord.batchId, moduleAttestation.moduleSerial)

recordedAt.description: review attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this review

scope.description: the constitutional gate / R-stage / amendment axis this review attests. R-stage activations gate cell `.solve()`; G4/G5 fossil-or-nuclear amendments and any N-gate amendment require Lv7 unanimity

decision.description: Council verdict; conditional-approve carries open conditions in `conditions`

councilLevelRequired.description: governance threshold for this scope; G4/G5 fossil-or-nuclear amendments and N-gate amendments require Lv7-unanimity, all other axes Lv6-supermajority (≥3 of the 5-of-7 Safe)

councilSafeAddress.description: the etzhayyim Public-Fund / Council 5-of-7 Safe address against which the signature quorum is verified

councilSignatures.description: Council Lv6+ attestation quorum (≥3 distinct members; Lv7-unanimity scopes require the full active Council). Each signature is over the canonical review bundle digest

engineeringAdvisoryAttestation.description: R1+: PV-process engineer(s) on Council technical advisory attesting the technical merits of the reviewed axis (≥1 required to activate R1 per ADR-2606021200)

provenanceAuditCid.description: G2: XUAR / forced-labor exclusion + conflict-mineral (In/Ga) chain-of-custody review (content-addressed); chains to polysiliconProvenanceAttestation.sourcingAuditCid

chemistryAuditCid.description: G3: NF₃/SF₆/CF₄ high-GWP gas ≥99% abatement + closed-loop slurry/acid recovery review (CID)

energyAuditCid.description: G4: renewable-only (hikari) process-energy + EPBT-margin review; NO fossil/nuclear at any tier (CID)

circularityAuditCid.description: G5: ≥90% recovery (kerf-Si / glass / Al frame / Cu) + design-for-disassembly + hodoki EOL-recycler review (CID); enforces the recyclability floor module_assembly only advisories

liberationMetricCid.description: G7: human tasks automated-away accounted to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000); transparent, non-opaque displacement review (CID)

sbomAuditCid.description: G8: per-lot/batch SBOM (CycloneDX → kotoba EAVT, ADR-2605312330) + CVE/provenance review (CID)

landSitingAuditCid.description: G9: brownfield / existing-industrial LANDS.md parcel + water-balance + effluent attestation review (CID); no greenfield habitat destruction

traceabilityAuditCid.description: G11: deterministic flash-IV + EL Ed25519-signed; module serial ↔ feedstock lot end-to-end traceability review (CID)

wellbecomingAuditCid.description: G14: §2(h) fab-worker safety (no toxic exposure), acoustic + light neighborhood audit, no addictive/dark-pattern review (CID)

conditions.description: open conditions attached to a conditional-approve (e.g. 'hikari R2 energy budget contract signed', '60-day public review elapsed', 'hodoki EOL recycler contract attested')

rationale.description: human-readable Council rationale for the decision (joucho-personality permitted; preserved verbatim in the Datom log)

decisionCid.description: content-addressed full decision dossier (deliberation record, evidence bundle, dissents); the authoritative long-form artifact this record summarizes

supersedesReviewId.description: reviewId this review supersedes, if it amends/overturns a prior decision (as-of history is preserved in the Datom log; this is the explicit forward link)

councilSignature.description: One Council member's Lv6+ attestation over the canonical review bundle digest. Quorum (≥3, or full Council for Lv7-unanimity scopes) is verified against `councilSafeAddress`.

councilMemberDid.description: DID of the attesting Council member (Lv6+)

councilLevel.description: the attesting member's ladder level at signing time

signature.description: signature over the canonical review bundle digest

engineerAttestation.description: PV-process engineer (Council technical-advisory) attestation of the technical merits of the reviewed axis. ≥1 required to activate R1 per ADR-2606021200. G7-coupled: engineer review of automated processes is logged so the Liberation Metric stays accountable.

engineerDid.description: DID of the attesting PV-process engineer

domain.description: the technical domain the engineer attests

signature.description: signature over the attested technical bundle
